title: Q10 · True length and traces
statement: 10) A line AB has its point A in HP and 30mm in front of VP and point B is in VP and 60mm above HP. The distance between the end projectors is 70mm. Draw its projections. Find the true length of the line and its inclinations with HP and VP. Also find its traces.
